notes.text: You can keep one shared shopping list with the people you shop with, tick items off and see who added them.
You can compare prices for the same product across shops and see which one is cheapest today.
You can sign in with a passkey, and add more passkeys from Settings.
You can invite people to your household from the People page.
You can open What's new from the account menu or the More page to see what changed.
You can pick the look of the app, Lifekit or Carbon, in Settings under Appearance. Lifekit is the default.
